question: Does the Q/T/midrank chart-difference residual outperform an equally large second T-PLE residual model, or is the gain explained by extra neural capacity?
control: Freeze the identical trained T-PLE anchor, then train an independent T-PLE tokenizer and same-family residual backbone behind the same exactly-zero scalar gate.
capacity_match: Adjust MLP/ResNet width or FT feed-forward width to minimize the difference in trainable parameters versus AnchorTriChart's residual branch.
training_match: Use the identical optimizer, schedule, loaders, validation fallback, seed offset, and anchor recipe as AnchorTriChart.
regression_pilot_gate: AnchorTriChart must have lower validation error than the T-only capacity control in at least 6/11 seed-27 cells, positive mean paired validation gain, and positive mean paired validation gain on at least 3/4 datasets before classification controls or new-data transfer.
gated_followup_frozen_after_control: Keep frozen-anchor T tokens as the residual base and add per-field exactly-zero Q-minus-T and midrank-minus-T gates; match total gradient-bearing residual parameters to the same capacity target.
gated_followup_gate: The gated residual must beat the T-only capacity control in at least 6/11 validation cells, have positive mean paired validation gain, and have positive mean paired validation gain on at least 3/4 datasets.
test_role: descriptive only after the validation comparison is complete
